name: Rose Garden
blurb: Nature lovers explore thousands of vibrant rose varieties spread across massive terraced slopes.

name: Ooty Lake
blurb: Travelers flock here for serene boat rides and scenic lakeside amusement activities.

name: Nilgiri Mountain Railway
blurb: Tourists ride this UNESCO World Heritage toy train for breathtaking views of the Nilgiri hills.

name: Doddabetta Peak
blurb: People climb to the highest point in the Nilgiri mountains for panoramic valley vistas.

name: Catherine Falls
blurb: Hikers and nature lovers visit to admire this stunning double-cascading waterfall amidst tea estates.

name: Mudumalai National Park
blurb: Wildlife enthusiasts take jungle safaris to spot elephants, tigers, and diverse bird species.

name: Chamundeshwari Temple
blurb: Pilgrims ascend Chamundi Hill to worship the revered Hindu goddess and enjoy city views.

name: Mysore Zoo
blurb: Families explore one of India's oldest and most well-maintained zoological gardens.

name: Mysore Palace
blurb: History buffs marvel at the opulent Indo-Saracenic architecture and royal heritage of the Wodeyars.
